items.title: Will The Recent Pipeline Progress Boost BMY's Portfolio Expansion?
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb's positive arlo-cel data in heavily pretreated multiple myeloma could strengthen its cell therapy pipeline.

items.title: IPO Stock LB Pharma Has Tripled In Under A Year. Is It A Takeover Target?
items.summary: LB Pharmaceuticals is on a tear. The IPO stock has more than tripled as investors watch its efforts in neuropsychiatric disorders.

items.title: A new immuno-oncology play raises $225M for a next-generation drug
items.summary: Solstice Oncology is advancing a medicine from China’s Harbour BioMed that it believes is able to address the weaknesses of drugs aimed at CTLA-4, a popular but tricky cancer immunotherapy target.

items.title: Is AbbVie Stock Too Reliant On Skyrizi?
items.summary: AbbVie (ABBV) trades at $256.46, roughly 96% of its 52-week high, after returning 24.1% over the past twelve months against 19.7% for the S&P 500. That price buys a business where about a third of guided 2026 revenue comes from one drug. The market reads that concentration as strength. It is worth reading it the other way too.

items.title: Here’s How Much You Need Invested to Collect $1,000 a Month in Dividends
items.summary: Collecting $1,000 a month in dividends sounds simple until you realize the capital required shifts every time prices move, and choosing the wrong yield can leave you exposed to a dividend cut when you can least afford it.

items.title: Roivant surges on ‘exceptional’ results; Bristol Myers touts first-of-its-kind CAR-T therapy
items.summary: One analyst views Roivant’s pulmonary hypertension drug as a future $10 billion-plus seller. Elsewhere, AstraZeneca overcame a negative advisory committee vote and Pharvaris claimed success in a key study.

items.title: What Merck Stopped Saying About GARDASIL Should Change What You Watch
items.summary: Merck (MRK) has returned about 85% over the past year and at about $150 trades roughly 4% below its 52-week high. A year ago, management spent earnings calls managing fallout from a steep drop in GARDASIL sales. That problem has left the lead. What management opens with instead is a much larger claim, and it settles years from now.

items.title: Social Security’s 2027 COLA Raise Is the Biggest in 3 Years — But These 5 Dividend Stocks Pay You More
items.summary: Social Security's projected 2027 COLA raise sounds promising until you realize retirees feel higher prices months before benefits catch up. Five blue-chip dividend stocks already pay yields that outpace that adjustment, and some have raised their payouts for decades straight.
